title: Urban flight simulation from the Flying DNA presentation
caption: Learning to navigate an urban environment.
description: A silent urban flight simulation taken from slide 6 of the Flying DNA presentation. A small four-rotor aircraft is shown above streets and intersections between multistory buildings. The rendered city includes cars, crosswalks, sidewalks, and reflective road surfaces. A broad yellow path or trail meets the aircraft and curves through the scene. The camera follows the aircraft from changing rear, elevated, and side viewpoints, first overlooking a street and an intersection, then moving closer to a building facade. The final view shows the aircraft beside the buildings with the yellow trace extending across the image. The complete original animation is retained at its original timing and resolution, without cropping, added motion, or audio. This is a drone simulation from the broader presentation; it does not by itself establish the aircraft model, controller, wind condition, quantitative performance, or identity of the city, and it is not footage of the 2025 eVTOL policy operating on a real aircraft.
credit: Source: Flying DNA presentation, slide 6, embedded animation. Converted to silent MP4 at its original speed; all 628 frames retained. Presentation supplied by the research team.
